title: Expose Search
description: Look up people, companies, and schools. Each valid row uses one Expose credit. The report is written to the dataset.

exposeApiKey.title: Expose API key
exposeApiKey.description: From Expose, under Integrations. Stored encrypted. Leave this empty only when the Actor environment variable EXPOSE_API_KEY is set on a private Actor.

searches.title: Searches
searches.description: One row is one search. A person needs an email, phone, or profile URL. A company or school needs a domain or a profile URL. When a row has more than one identifier, the Actor uses email, then phone, then profile URL for a person, and domain, then profile URL for a company or school.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Person only. Include the country code, for example +14155551234.

profileUrl.title: Profile URL
profileUrl.description: A public profile URL for a person, company, or school.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Company or school only. For example stripe.com or mit.edu.
